versions.content: Header Validation Failure Security Event Status: DRAFT If DoIPEnableSecurityEventReporting is enabled and SEV_DOIP_HEADER_ CHECK_FAILED exists, the DoIP module shall report the security event SEV_DOIP_HEADER_CHECK_FAILED to IdsM with the context data specified in [SWS_DoIP_00511] when a message is rejected due to a failure in generic acknowl- edgement checks. These checks include: • Incorrect protocol information • Unsupported payload type • Payload length exceeding DoIPMaxRequestBytes • Inability to provide a buffer of the required length • Payload length that is not valid for the specific payload type
